title: Clinical screening of Nocardia in sputum smears based on neural networks.
summary: YOLOv5x detects Nocardia in thick-smear images; on the 2,571 labeled-image dataset it reported a 92.79% F-score and 94.40% mAP@0.5, with a prototype microscope/app integration.
ai_technology: the learned operation enabling the specific result: A neural network screened sputum smears for Nocardia with a clinical diagnostic application.
organization: Department of Laboratory Medicine, Tongde Hospital of Zhejiang Province, Hangzhou, China
